recognize_zh: 抹片較厚區域中大量中到大型淋巴球，細胞質量多且呈淡藍到深藍色、核圓且染色質略開放，看起來像母細胞；但混有成熟嗜中性球，細胞大小與形態呈連續光譜而非單一型態，符合登革熱的反應性（轉化型）淋巴球。
features: Numerous medium to large lymphoid cells with moderate to abundant pale-to-deep basophilic cytoplasm
Round to slightly indented nuclei with moderately condensed to partly open chromatin; some appear blast-like
Heterogeneous spectrum of cell size and cytoplasmic basophilia rather than a monotonous population
Thick, poorly spread area of the smear with overlapping cells, limiting fine nuclear detail
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, from a thick area of the film, shows numerous medium to large lymphoid cells admixed with segmented neutrophils. The lymphoid cells have moderate to abundant basophilic cytoplasm and round to indented nuclei with somewhat open chromatin, imparting a blast-like appearance. However, the cells show a range of sizes and cytoplasmic basophilia, without Auer rods or a monotonous blast population. Interpretation is limited by cell crowding in this thick area. In the clinical context of dengue infection, findings are consistent with reactive (transformed) lymphocytosis mimicking blasts; flow cytometry can be used if doubt persists.

ddx.vs: Blasts form a monotonous population with fine uniform chromatin, high N:C ratio and scant cytoplasm, whereas these cells are heterogeneous with abundant basophilic cytoplasm.
Plasma cells show eccentric nuclei with a perinuclear hof and clock-face chromatin, which are not prominent in this heterogeneous population.

ddx.dx: Circulating lymphoma cells (e.g., large B-cell lymphoma)
ddx.vs: Lymphoma cells are clonal and more uniform with nuclear irregularity; a light-chain-restricted or aberrant phenotype on flow cytometry separates them from reactive cells.
